documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Update On Proposed Investment In M/S. V.S. Industries Private Limited

analysis.summary: Somany Ceramics reported a robust performance in Q2 FY27 with consolidated revenue rising 25.4% year-on-year to INR 854 crore and EBITDA improving to INR 100 crore, aided by a richer product mix, operating leverage, and cost efficiencies. Domestic demand remained healthy across retail and project segments driven by steady housing and renovation activity, whereas exports stayed under pressure due to high fuel and freight costs and trade disruptions. Management expressed confidence in strengthening its competitive position and delivering superior shareholder value through market leadership, brand equity, and operational execution. Management reported a 3% growth in sales volume and 24% in value for Q1 FY27, impacted by production shutdowns in Morbi during April. EBITDA margins expanded to 11.6% due to higher capacity utilization reaching 83% in stand-alone plants and turnaround of joint ventures to profitability.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver mid-single-digit volume growth for the year.
guidance.quote: So for this year, sir, what kind of volumes you see? Abhishek Somany: Mid-single digits.

guidance.claim: Management maintains that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter will be maintained and improved.
guidance.quote: And we maintain that the EBITDA margins delivered in this quarter would be maintained, and we are trying to better our EBITDA margins, which we have delivered in last quarter and on this quarter.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand remained healthy across both the retail and project segments, driven by steady housing activity and renovation demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Domestic demand remained healthy across both the retail and project segments, driven by steady housing activity and renovation demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Exports remained under pressure, with high fuel and freight costs and trade-related disruptions eroding their global competitiveness.
demand_outlook.quote: Exports, on the other hand, remained under pressure, with high fuel and freight costs and trade-related disruptions eroding their global competitiveness

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in May and June was pretty decent, and July has been acceptable despite rains in many parts of the country.
demand_outlook.quote: Other than that, the demand of May and June has been pretty decent. July also has been not bad considering that there's been rains in many parts of the country.

demand_outlook.claim: Overall, management is extremely bullish on the future outlook of demand.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, we are extremely bullish of the future outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains optimistic about industry growth prospects supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the industry’s growth prospects, supported by sustained demand from housing, infrastructure, and renovation segments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced setting up a 9-plus million square meter plant in the South with an approximate outlay of INR220 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months. This would give us a potential revenue of about INR350 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is adding 4 million to 5 million square meters through existing lines in Bahadurgarh, Gujarat, Morbi, and the South.
capex_expansion.quote: Other than that, we are taking many more steps, which are all work in progress to augment further capacity by about 4 million to 5 million in our existing lines in Bahadurgarh in -- which is in Haryana and in Gujarat and in Morbi and also in the South.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capex outlay from now to the end of FY27 is approximately INR275 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So from now to '27 end, we have already looked at approximately INR275 crores outlay, which includes the INR220 crores plant plus balancing equipment in various other plants and some more balancing equipment in the Bathware, sanitaryware plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The company announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm of Glazed Vitrified Tiles to cater to the growing Southern market.
capex_expansion.quote: To cater to the growing Southern market, the Company has announced a new manufacturing facility with an annual capacity of approximately 9 million+ sqm. of Glazed Vitrified Tiles.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved to 11.7%, aided by a richer product mix, operating leverage, and a sustained focus on cost efficiency.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA grew to INR 100 crore, and EBITDA margin improved to 11.7%, aided by a richer product mix, operating leverage and a sustained focus on cost efficiency.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter increased by 3.6% to 11.6% due to operational efficiencies and capacity utilization.
margins_costs.quote: As a result of capacity utilization, our EBITDA margins have gone up on operational efficiencies, both on capacity utilization in our plants and also on the JV performances. So EBITDA margins go up by 3.6% to 11.6% for the quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Gas prices increased between 16% and 18%, and the company successfully passed on all gas price increases.
margins_costs.quote: So the current price increase has been between 16% and 18%. Other than that, the demand of May and June has been pretty decent. July also has been not bad considering that there's been rains in many parts of the country.

margins_costs.claim: The company's blended natural gas price is about INR68.
margins_costs.quote: Yes. So our blended price comes in at about INR68.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6% driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 11.6%, driven by product mix improvement and continued focus on operational efficiencies.

orders_capacity.claim: Morbi operations have resumed 100% production since the end of May.
orders_capacity.quote: May end onwards, they've been absolutely at 100% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: Consolidated Net Debt includes INR 25 Cr Debt taken for solar and other energy-related investments.
capital_allocation.quote: Consolidated Net Debt includes INR 25 Cr Debt taken for solar/other energy related investments.

capital_allocation.claim: Working capital days came down from 17 to 12 days.
capital_allocation.quote: Working capital days also have come down from 17 to 12 days.

capital_allocation.claim: About 60% to 70% of the planned capex will be funded through internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports faced high fuel and freight costs along with trade-related disruptions that eroded global competitiveness.
risks_headwinds.quote: Exports, on the other hand, remained under pressure, with high fuel and freight costs and trade-related disruptions eroding their global competitiveness

risks_headwinds.claim: Exports from Morbi were down 50% to 60% from the peak due to geopolitical reasons.
risks_headwinds.quote: The only negative in the quarter has been from a Morbi perspective is exports has been down due to geopolitical reasons, the export is down a good 50%, 60% from the peak.

risks_headwinds.claim: Gas price has been extremely volatile with small increases every month.
risks_headwinds.quote: The gas price has been extremely volatile. I had mentioned that in the earnings call for the FY26, but the gas price since then has been extremely volatile. Every month, there have been a small increases in gas price.

risks_headwinds.claim: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The quarter witnessed supply-side disruptions in the Morbi cluster due to fuel shortages, labour unavailability, and elevated gas prices, resulting in production curtailments across the industry.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated confidence in further strengthening its competitive position and delivering superior value to its shareholders, backed by a strong balance sheet, a growing market presence, and a disciplined approach to capital allocation.
management_commitments.quote: Backed by a strong balance sheet, a growing market presence and a disciplined approach to capital allocation, we are confident of further strengthening our competitive position and delivering superior value to our shareholders.

management_commitments.claim: The new plant in the South will be up and ready in the next 12 to 15 months.
management_commitments.quote: Because of that, we have announced setting up a 9 million square meter plant -- 9-plus million square meter plant in the South, which would be up and ready by in the next 12 to 15 months.

management_commitments.claim: Capacity enhancements through existing lines will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and completely in place in quarter 4.
management_commitments.quote: All put together, we will be adding another 4 million to 5 million for the mid -- this will be ready from mid-quarter 3 and would be completely in place in quarter 4.

management_commitments.claim: The new South plant will be operational by the end of quarter 3 or beginning of quarter 4 of next year.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, end of quarter 3, beginning quarter 4 of next year, it will be operational.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company's focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.
management_commitments.quote: Our focus will remain on delivering profitable growth through market share gains, product premiumization, higher capacity utilization, disciplined cost management, and stronger cash flow generation.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company will continue to leverage its strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.
management_commitments.quote: We will continue to leverage our strong brand equity and extensive distribution network to capitalize on emerging market opportunities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
